fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5% of Net Billings, payable weekly. A Minimum Royalty Fee applies (greater of Royalty Fee or Minimum Royalty Fee per Quarter, per Basic Terms). Local Marketing is 2% of Net Billings unless a Cap applies, spent locally in the Designated Area. Brand Marketing and Promotion Fee is tiered: 2% of weekly Net Billings on the first $1,000,000 of Net Billings plus 1% of weekly Net Billings on the next $2,000,000 of Net Billings per calendar year, payable weekly; subject to an MSA Cap for multi-unit owners in a defined geographical area. A Minimum Brand Marketing and Promotion Fee also applies (greater of Brand Marketing and Promotion Fee or Minimum per Quarter). Additional fees include: Audit cost if understatement ≥2%; Late Fee of $50/week per item (up to $250/week) plus up to 1.5%/month interest; Insurance premium reimbursement if franchisee fails to maintain required coverage; Renewal Fee of 10% of then-current initial franchise fee per Renewal Term.
